title: O Soul-bride, Without Your Husband Lord, What
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 18
summary: Gratitude is carried here from o soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations? toward o Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels dull, entitled, forgetful, because it keeps gratitude inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Gratitude steadies when o Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhirag jeevan dhohaaganee muThee dhoojai bhai ||
lines.translation: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalar keree ka(n)dh jiau ahinis kir ddeh pai ||
lines.translation: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadhai sukh naa theeaai pir bin dhookh na jai ||1||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||
O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhar ghar ddoiee na lahai dharageh jhooTh khuaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap sujaan na bhuliee sachaa vadd kirasaan ||
lines.translation: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa dharatee saadh kai sach naam dhe dhaan ||
lines.translation: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh upajai naam ek karam pavai neesaan ||2||
lines.translation: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kau jaan na jaaniee kiaa tis chaj achaar ||
lines.translation: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhulai naam visaariaa manmukh a(n)dh gubaar ||
lines.translation: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan na chukiee mar janamai hoi khuaar ||3||
lines.translation: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)dhan mol anaiaa ku(n)goo maa(n)g sa(n)dhoor ||
lines.translation: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: choaa cha(n)dhan bahu ghanaa paanaa naal kapoor ||
lines.translation: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: je dhan ka(n)t na bhaaviee ta sabh adda(n)bar kooR ||4||
lines.translation: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ras bhogan baadh heh sabh seegaar vikaar ||
lines.translation: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag sabadh na bhedheeaai kiau sohai gurdhuaar ||
lines.translation: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dha(n)n suhaaganee jin seh naal piaar ||5||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: o soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: o Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband.
